purpose: Pressure-test routing when source-explicit relations and tempting derived relations coexist or conflict.

source_policy.note: No user document or source corpus is modified; this fixture is an isolated synthetic artifact.

expected_invariants: A-B must never be upgraded to source_explicit merely because it is spatially close.
A-C must remain source_explicit membership even though it is spatially distant.
A-B must not satisfy a gate requiring source-explicit topology or membership.
Routing may retain both relations simultaneously without collapsing relation_semantics into relation_origin.
Derived relation must retain derivation rule, threshold, fields, and source record IDs.
